mapper.select: SELECT id, schedule_id, user_id, send_id, idempotency_key, channel, status, evaluated_at, sent_at, failed_reason FROM notification_dispatch_target WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_dispatch_target SET status = #{status}, failed_reason = #{failedReason}, sent_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SENT' THEN now() ELSE sent_at END, evaluated_at = CASE WHEN evaluated_at IS NULL THEN now() ELSE evaluated_at END WHERE id = #{id}
